title: Api episodes
description: The body of GET /api/episodes: one page of episodes, newest first. An episode groups the suspect events and decisions of one continuing symptom, so the technician sees one story instead of a stream. `next_cursor` is the opaque token of the next page and is null on the last one. The episode definition below is the one the WebSocket snapshot frame embeds.

episode.title: Episode
episode.description: One continuing symptom on one unit, from the first suspect event to the moment silence, a discontinuity or a technician closed it.

symptom_key.description: The symptom the episode was opened on.

symptom_keys.description: Every symptom seen inside the episode, in first-seen order.

status.description: open while events keep arriving, closed after it resolved, aborted when a replay jump cut it short.

last_decision_sim_ts.description: Data time of the newest decision, null while none was made.

closed_sim_ts.description: Data time the episode closed at, null while it is open.

close_reason.description: Why the episode closed, null while it is open.

ticket_id.description: The ticket this episode produced, null while it produced none.

items.description: The episodes of this page, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token of the next page, null on the last one.
